# What This Document Addresses

Volume III establishes that the payload — not the pipe — is the unprotected surface, and that classification, movement restriction, and agency-controlled encryption are the closing mechanisms. This book deploys them: the CUI label taxonomy as code, DLP policies as versioned packs, and key management (customer-managed keys, rotation, revocation) as infrastructure — so the data-layer controls are reproducible and auditable.

# Deployable Artifacts

| Artifact | Realizes (Vol III) | Deployed example | Multi-CSP substitution |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sensitivity-label taxonomy (CUI tiers, parent/child, protection settings) | Information classification & marking | Purview labels via PowerShell/Graph as code | AWS Macie classifications; data-tagging policy |
| DLP policy packs (service/endpoint/network) | AC-4 movement restriction | Purview DLP as code | Symantec/Forcepoint DLP policy-as-code |
| Key management (CMK/BYOK, rotation, access policy) | SC-12/12(1), SC-28 | Key Vault + CMK Terraform | AWS KMS + CloudHSM as code |
| Audit-retention configuration | AU-10 non-repudiation, retention | Purview Audit tier + export as code | CloudTrail Lake retention config |

# Closure Necessity

::: {.callout-tip}
## Closure Necessity — a label the pipe can read is what makes payload control possible
Volume III shows a network boundary cannot enforce "block external sharing of CUI" because it cannot read the payload. This book deploys the label that carries the classification *with* the file, and the keys the agency alone can rotate — the deployed form of the payload-protection mechanism. Without a machine-readable label taxonomy and agency-held keys, AC-4 and SC-12 are policy statements no control enforces.
:::

# Controls Operationalized

| Control | Title | How this book deploys it |
|---|---|---|
| AC-4 | Information Flow Enforcement | Label-derived DLP movement restriction |
| SC-12/12(1) | Cryptographic Key Establishment & Management | CMK/BYOK, rotation, revocation as code |
| SC-28 | Protection of Information at Rest | CMK-backed encryption of classified stores |
| AU-10 | Non-repudiation | Premium audit tier + immutable export |
